summary: Preserve a bounded, typed Parallel Free result through canonical runs, MCP, native agent and voice readback.
reason: The existing run and fast-path projections cannot safely carry citations or distinguish partial Web results and trusted execution metadata.

tests.name: Web run and actual S24 legacy envelope
Web MCP canonical identity and dedup
Web voice source protocol, not acoustic acceptance
Native SDK agent authority and opaque identity

capabilities.reason: Execution contracts, transport metadata and typed presentation change in core. Canonical capability creation and registry changes belong to the paired playbooks PR163; core adds neither a duplicate catalogue nor a new route.

architecture.reason: Reuse existing run registry, Graph helper, authenticated MCP/agent and voice owners; additive optional projection, no additional store, service or routing layer.
architecture.dialogue_v22: Web hand-off executed only through the V2.2 dialogue coordinator execute port (FastPathPorts/execute_resolved); no SurfaceClarifications, no pending state outside the coordinator; G6 voice gate before dispatch in the port; web projection carried in coordinator reply metadata and revalidated by Companion.

limitations: Runtime activation and real Parallel/Gemini searches not performed.
Live Web dispatch defaults closed. Only host CLAW_PUBLIC_WEB_VOICE_RECIPE=1 opens the G6 recipe; audio exactness and cost remain unqualified, and transcript checks are post-generation.
Native SDK tool replay after restart is not a new durable guarantee.
Read cancellation propagates only when the existing caller supplies a signal; voice interruption does not cancel business execution.
rollback: Revert this scoped core release through the existing deployment owner; older readers ignore optional run.web without deleting receipts or replaying work.

mcp_owner_parity.reason: Six MCP tool schemas and admission remain unchanged. Resolve binds its host request identity; execute carries ephemeral budget outside paramsHash, returns the canonical web payload and reuses durable Bridge status. Raw shell and artifact storage are not Web implementation paths. Live activation remains pending.
